name: Hypr Logo Cursor
tagline: Installs the Hyprland droplet cursor on Omarchy at 24-48px
description: A small, focused Linux desktop utility. It installs the Hyprland droplet pointer theme on an Omarchy setup at whatever size you pick between 24 and 48 pixels, pulling the artwork from the project's own pixel set instead of third-party cursor packs so nothing unvetted lands on your machine.
author: tim_sonner
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
